description: Search Italian national legislation (laws, decree-laws, legislative decrees, the Constitution, regulations, …) by full-text words, title words, act type and/or date range. Returns matching acts with their act type, title, emanation date, publication (Gazzetta Ufficiale) date kept separate from emanation date, and a constructed `urn` field for chaining into it_normattiva_get_act / it_normattiva_get_article. Pass in_force_on (YYYY-MM-DD) to restrict to acts in force on that date. act_type takes the official Italian label, e.g. "LEGGE", "DECRETO LEGISLATIVO", "DECRETO-LEGGE", "COSTITUZIONE", "REGOLAMENTO". Free-text query matching is OR-across-words over the whole corpus (not an exact phrase), so narrow with title/act_type/dates for tight results. Source: Istituto Poligrafico e Zecca dello Stato (IPZS), Normattiva Open Data.

in_force_on.description: YYYY-MM-DD — restrict to acts in force on this date.

publication_date_from.description: YYYY-MM-DD — earliest Gazzetta Ufficiale publication date.

publication_date_to.description: YYYY-MM-DD — latest Gazzetta Ufficiale publication date.

query.description: Full-text search words, e.g. "protezione dei dati personali".

title.description: Words to match in the act's title.

name: it_normattiva_search
title: It Normattiva Search
